notes.title: Update 1.7.0! Episode 4 "Garden" and Beekeeping
notes.content:
I've finally made a new full episode of The Garden! It harmonizes several of the game's features and is the biggest and most challenging. It has over 100 levels and many of them are large in size with epic difficulty.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44732593/ed3aa2ac997bc9cfb77b2deb6882f602cac13819.png[/img]

The Hexagonal goal is now unlocked in Episode 4, and the new Beekeeping mini-game has built in an Advanced hexagonal mode.

The last missing scroll will now become available in this episode. It reveals several digits of "1" at the beginning of the level.

[h3]What's in the update:[/h3]
[list]
[*] New episode 4 "Garden" for 100+ levels!
[*] A new mini game "Beekeeping"
[*] Advanced hexagonal mode is now built into the mini game
[*] 3 new achievements for the mini game
[*] A new scroll that reveals multiple digits of "1"
[*] New minefield skin
[*] The goal "Hexagonal" is now unlocked in Episode 4
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.6.0! New save format and profiles
notes.content:
The new format of saves allowed to simplify the work with data and greatly reduce the weight. This is especially true for profiles and future hundreds of new levels.

Profiles allow you to start a new game or let someone else play without losing your main progress. You can have up to three profiles and switch between them.

I was also informed that the fishing design is difficult for people with colorblindness. I added a new "Color shift" option to the game settings. It makes fishing and some of the designs more contrasty without a major deviation in colors. Hope this helps.

[h3]What's in the update:[/h3]
[list]
[*] New format for saves
[*] Save Profiles
[*] "Color shift" option to improve readability of some level designs
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.5.0! Steam Deck and controllers support
notes.content:
There's been a big break with updates. All because I started to make a new powerful generator of solvable levels. At first the work progressed well, but then it became clear that quality implementation will take much more time. After almost a month and a half I realized that it would take the same amount of time to take into account all the features and modes. That's why I decided to postpone the generator for some time and to deal with other important tasks.
The first such task was to support controllers. For me it was the first experience and it took a lot of time to figure out how everything works. As a result, now the game can be played on Steam Deck or on PC with a controller. Not everything is perfect yet, there are some minor inconveniences when laying out fish for packing. In addition, the editor is not supported.
I will be glad to any tips for improvement.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44732593/41bc6fa9d25a80dcdd183b9717e2b9bcab878b76.png[/img]

[h3]What's in the update:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Support for Steam Deck and Xbox, PlayStation controllers
[*] The "Advanced hexagonal" experimental mode has become more difficult
[*] Minor improvements
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.4.0! Advanced hexagonal
notes.content:
I'm very excited to introduce you to a new game mode! I call it "Advanced Hexagonal". The idea is that some cells on the field are combined into one large one, which can be of different sizes and shapes.
The interaction between large and regular cells follows the classical neighborhood principle, but large cells have more neighbors and the numbers can be much larger than 6.
The interesting thing is that large cells can contain several mines. But not more than the number of regular cells that make up a large cell. The maximum capacity of mines can be easily read by looking at the cell.
And since there can be several mines in a cell, it should be possible to set several marks. I did not immediately come to the current option of setting marks.
The hardest part was making this mode guaranteed to be solvable. I succeeded, but there is still work to be done.

[h3]The biggest number I've ever seen is 13. Share your records![/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44732593/1e2ef03f7d0a6de47b02ae47785a24196612304c.jpg[/img]

[h3]What's in the update:[/h3]
[list]
[*] A new experimental mode "Advanced hexagonal"!
[*] Minor fixes
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.3.0! Classic and Ancient Book
notes.content:
Finally an update! I needed a vacation, but now I'm back in the thick of the game. I decided to start with the classic mode and competitive leaderboards, and at the same time carry over some achievements from the first game and add new ones.
Achievements where you need to spend less seconds than the mines on each level are really very challenging and gold will be obtained by a few!
Also, I got rid of the timers in the ancient book. It now requires coins and a reasonable amount of runes to break the seal.

[h3]Classic:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Classic mode now has 6 regular and 6 hexagonal levels
[*] A stopwatch appeared on these levels
[*] When winning, a window with the result has been added, and the field can be moved and scaled to make it easier to share records
[*] Added 12 leaderboards
[*] Added 16 achievements
[/list]

[h3]The rest:[/h3]
[list]
[*] In the ancient book, the seal breaking timer has been replaced by runes
[*] Added 1 fishing achievement
[*] Improved various sounds in the game
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.2.0! Fishing
notes.content:
This update is mostly about fishing. The more often you use a packaging, the easier it becomes to use it. And the new upgrade for fish storage will give you a better understanding of which package to choose!

[h3]New for fishing:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Progress with upgrades for each package
[olist]
[*] After the first package upgrade, a button appears to lay out the fish
[*] Subsequent upgrades increase lay out speed
[/olist]
[*] New "Convenient packaging" upgrade for fish storage
[olist]
[*] The first level of upgrade highlights the available suitable packages
[*] The second level of upgrade highlights the fish that are not enough to package
[/olist]
[*] Changed some fishing sounds
[/list]
[h3]The rest:[/h3]
[list]
[*] In classic mode, the minefield scale has been adjusted when winning
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.1.1!
notes.content:
[h3]I continue to work on fixes and improvements to the game based on your opinions and feedback![/h3]
I don't have enough time to do everything I need to do quickly, some important improvements take a lot of time. I will try to make updates every week to release different improvements faster.

[h3]Improvements based on player requests:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Reduced the time required for an alchemist to break seals
[*] To donate runes faster you need to press and hold the mouse button on the selected rune
[*] In a minefield, it makes no difference which button you click on a numbers (option in settings)
[*] Speed up animations almost everywhere! Activated with any click or key
[*] Option in settings to automatically speed up animation
[*] Option in settings to disable the color adjustments effect
[*] A confirmation is requested when exiting the game
[/list]
[h3]The rest:[/h3]
[list]
[*] More support for Enter and Esc keys
[*] Supports spacebar, numpad Enter (works like Enter), Backspace (works like Esc) keys
[*] Removed splash screen when entering the game
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.1.0 and a week after launch!
notes.content:
[h2]I want to thank all the players! There are already more than 750 of you! Looks like my dream of 1000 in a month is coming true![/h2]

All week I have been fixing and improving the game based on your opinions and feedback. Thank you for writing so much, I read everything and write it down for the future.
Today I have prepared an update, which contains various improvements for a more enjoyable game play. In addition, 3 new languages have been added! All translations are done by the players, thank you very much! Feel free to leave your comments and edits in Steam community, in comments, or at itetra2d@gmail.com

[h3]So, what's in the update:[/h3]
[list]
[*] New languages! Latin American Spanish, Portuguese, Brazilian Portuguese.
[*] Backup save to documents when enter into the game. For cases of Steam Cloud not working properly
[*] Improved interface at the end of the level
[*] Added access to the storyline without going to the map, if the level is not passed for the first time
[*] Enter and Esc keys work more predictably and in more places
[*] Customize disabling for vignette and chromatic aberration effects
[*] Adjusting the sensitivity threshold between clicking and moving the field
[*] Ancient Book now has a description of the selected level variation and a hint with the effect of the number of runes on speeding up seal removal
[/list]
[h3]Improvements will continue![/h3]

notes.title: Update 0.4.0 for Demo!
notes.content:
Last month I have been working a lot on the story mode of fishing, about which I will make a separate post. Besides it was realized a lot of wishes of players, but not all of the planned.

📜 What's in the update:
- Fixed (I hope) a rare bug that prevented you from returning to the map after completing a level
- Each level now has 3 goals. The fourth goal "All difficulties" can be purchased in the episode extras
- Improved tutorial and redesigned the principle of hints appearance. Now instead of the hint itself there is a button to call it up
- Improved responsiveness of the controls
- You can now click on a number to reveal the cells around it with the middle mouse button
- You can now move the camera using WASD and arrows. Can be changed in the control settings during the game
- Added the option to reset all game progress
- Various minor improvements and fixes
